item.title: Claude vs DeepSeek and Moonshot: How chinese labs “siphoned” 16 million answers to bridge the AI gap
item.description: In a detailed report released on February 23, 2026, the artificial intelligence safety lab Anthropic formally accused three of China’s most prominent AI entities—DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, and MiniMax—of executing “industrial-scale distillation attacks.” The campaign allegedly involved the creation of roughly 24,000 fraudulent accounts to generate over 16 million exchanges with Claude.
